18+ Years of Excellence

Life Reimagined, A Future Shaped By Better Design.

Established in 2006, Assetz Property Group (widely recognized as Assetz Group Bangalore) is one of South India's premier real estate developers, headquartered in Singapore with its operational center in Karnataka. Guided by our foundational motto—"Life Reimagined"—and driven by a strict "Better Design" philosophy, Assetz builders have delivered over 20 million square feet of landmark commercial IT business parks (including the pioneering LEED Platinum-certified Embassy TechVillage) and luxury residential communities. As pioneers of sustainable architecture, Assetz Property Group Bangalore seamlessly integrates carbon-healing green campuses, 75%+ open green spaces, zero-water waste management, and global institutional investment backing across Bengaluru’s key growth hubs.

Explore the exclusive portfolio of Assetz Property Bangalore, offering premier apartments for sale in Bangalore, luxury flats for sale in Bangalore, and ready to move flats in Bangalore across prime IT corridors. Compare projects from top Assetz builders, from iconic lakefront communities like Assetz East Point Bangalore in Bellandur to sustainable high-rise apartments and luxury plotted developments in Devanahalli, Whitefield, and Sarjapur Road. Discover premier Assetz apartments, evaluate master floor plans, and stay informed on Assetz upcoming projects in Bangalore engineered for long-term appreciation, wellness, and refined luxury living.

Project Narrative

Architectural Overview

Assetz Muse & Maison is a high-end, low-density boutique residential project by Assetz Property Group located in Gattahalli, off Hosa Road and Sarjapur Road in South-East Bengaluru. Spread across 2.14 acres with 78% open spaces, the development comprises a single high-rise tower (Basement + Ground + 16 Floors) housing just 128 exclusive 3 BHK luxury residences. Anchored by a 13,000 sq. ft. modern clubhouse, the project features temperature-controlled swimming pools, padel tennis courts, biophilic design elements, and terracotta jaali screens for passive cooling. Buyers researching Assetz builders can explore Assetz Property Group homes in Gattahalli, Off Hosa Road / Sarjapur Road, South-East Bengaluru, with project status, location, and configuration details available to compare.

Assetz Muse & Maison is listed with 3 BHK Boutique High-Rise Residences (128 Units) across 2.14 Acres, with new launch status and possession scheduled for March 2030. Listed floor plan options include 3 BHK Middle Unit and 3 BHK Corner Unit. Residents can explore lifestyle amenities such as 13,000 Sq. Ft. Boutique Resident Clubhouse, 78% Open Spaces & Zen Landscaped Gardens, Temperature-Controlled Swimming Pool & Sun Deck and Padel Tennis Court & Pickleball Courts, with nearby destinations including Sarjapur Main Road (3.0 km), Electronic City Phase 1 (4.5 km) and Hosa Road Metro Station (Yellow Line) (5.5 km). Review this Assetz Property Group project’s floor plans, amenities, and connectivity when comparing homes in Bengaluru.
